picks.title: Meta's Muse agent gains access to ad accounts and 15 business tools
picks.excerpt: Small businesses in the US and Canada can now connect Shopify, QuickBooks and their Meta ad accounts to Meta's Muse agent. Nothing gets spent without the owner's sign-off, and the piece looks at what the agent is able to change in a campaign.
picks.rationale: New capability: Meta's own AI agent can now act inside SMB ad accounts (with spend sign-off), which directly changes who runs Meta campaigns.

picks.title: “AI가 쇼핑 다 해주면 광고는 누가 보나”…네이버·아마존, 문 걸어잠근다
picks.excerpt: Amazon blocked Meta's Muse agent from shopping on its site, and Naver and Coupang are also cutting off outside AI agents. Agents that search and pay on a user's behalf skip the platform's ad slots, recommendations and lock-in. Google, Walmart and Shopify are going the other way and opening checkout to agents (UCP, a shared standard for agent identity and delegated permissions).
picks.rationale: Concrete platform moves (Amazon, Naver and Coupang blocking outside shopping agents) driven by the threat AI agents pose to retail-media ad slots; a split from the open-checkout camp that commerce advertisers have to plan around.

picks.title: Brands can block YouTube ads beside AI slop under new IAS tool
picks.excerpt: A new IAS tool lets YouTube buyers keep their ads off low-quality generative-AI channels. Exclusion lists refresh daily and are built from YouTube Data API signals that Google does not review.
picks.rationale: New brand-safety product aimed specifically at generative-AI slop channels on YouTube; buyers can apply the daily exclusion lists right away.

picks.title: 네카오, AI 수익화 경쟁 본격화…이용자 4000만 정조준
picks.excerpt: Naver's AI Briefing ads, launched in late July, get a click-through rate 30%+ above standard search ads and more than 3x the purchase conversion. AI drove over 60% of Naver's Q2 ad revenue growth. Kakao plans to route intent from KakaoTalk conversations into ordering and payment through its agents, and to monetize AI from next year, targeting double-digit AI share of Talk Biz revenue by 2028.
picks.rationale: Hard performance numbers for ads placed inside AI search answers (Naver AI Briefing: CTR +30%, 3x conversion), plus Kakao's agent-commerce monetization roadmap; this is the Korean counterpart to the ChatGPT ads story.

picks.title: 비용 줄이려다 손님도 줄어드네…소비자들 외면하는 AI 광고
picks.excerpt: Korean consumers are pushing back against ad photos and videos made with generative AI: AI-generated fashion models, food photos on menus, AI video ads on YouTube and in theaters. They say the ads kill the urge to buy and lower trust. Experts cite research showing that the more AI shoppers perceive in an ad's production, the less authentic it seems.
picks.rationale: Covers ad creative, the one category the other picks miss: consumer pushback against generative-AI ads, backed by research saying visible AI production lowers authenticity and purchase intent. Relevant to anyone producing creative with gen-AI.
